jp: ヴェルニースの南にあるネフィアの迷宮群のひとつ《レシマス》で、何かが見つかるかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "ヴェルニースの南にあるネフィアの迷宮群のひとつ《レシマス》で、何かが見つかるかもしれない。"
en: I should check the dungeon called Lesimas. It's located south of Vernis.
en_grezzo: "I should check the dungeon called Lesimas. It's located south of Vernis."
it: Forse a Lesimas si trova qualcosa: è uno dei labirinti di Nefia a sud di Vernis.

jp: レミード遺跡最下層の怪物を倒そう。
jp_grezzo: "レミード遺跡最下層の怪物を倒そう。"
en: I need to defeat the monster on the lowest floor of Remido.
en_grezzo: "I need to defeat the monster on the lowest floor of Remido."
it: Devo abbattere il mostro in fondo alle Rovine di Remido.

jp: ポート・カプールの船長に紹介状を見せよう。
jp_grezzo: "ポート・カプールの船長に紹介状を見せよう。"
en: I should show the boat captain in Port Kapul my letter of introduction.
en_grezzo: "I should show the boat captain in Port Kapul my letter of introduction."
it: Devo mostrare al capitano di Porto Kapul la lettera di presentazione.

jp: ノルンの言うとおりにノースティリスと往復が出来るのか確かめよう。
jp_grezzo: "ノルンの言うとおりにノースティリスと往復が出来るのか確かめよう。"
en: I need to find out if I can make a round trip between North Tyris and Lost Irva like Norne said.
en_grezzo: "I need to find out if I can make a round trip between North Tyris and Lost Irva like Norne said."
it: Norne dice che si può fare avanti e indietro fra Tyris del Nord e Irva Perduta: devo verificarlo.

jp: サウスティリスの方向から、何かに呼ばれているような感覚がする。
jp_grezzo: "サウスティリスの方向から、何かに呼ばれているような感覚がする。"
en: I feel as if I'm being called by something in South Tyris.
en_grezzo: "I feel as if I'm being called by something in South Tyris."
it: Qualcosa mi chiama da Tyris del Sud.

jp: 関所にいるエユルとともに生体兵器を殲滅しよう。
jp_grezzo: "関所にいるエユルとともに生体兵器を殲滅しよう。"
en: I need to meet up with Regulus at the inn at North Tyris' border with South Tyris in order to defeat the biological weapon.
en_grezzo: "I need to meet up with Regulus at the inn at North Tyris' border with South Tyris in order to defeat the biological weapon."
it: Devo sterminare le armi biologiche insieme a Regulus, che è al valico.

jp: メイルーンの悪魔の討伐をエリステアに報告しよう。
jp_grezzo: "メイルーンの悪魔の討伐をエリステアに報告しよう。"
en: I've defeated the demon in Mayroon. I should report to Erystia in Palmia.
en_grezzo: "I've defeated the demon in Mayroon. I should report to Erystia in Palmia."
it: Il demone di Mayroon è stato abbattuto. Devo riferirlo a Erystia, a Palmia.

jp: エウダーナの悪魔の討伐をエリステアに報告しよう。
jp_grezzo: "エウダーナの悪魔の討伐をエリステアに報告しよう。"
en: The demon in Eulderna has been defeated. I should report to Erystia in Palmia.
en_grezzo: "The demon in Eulderna has been defeated. I should report to Erystia in Palmia."
it: Il demone di Eulderna è stato abbattuto. Devo riferirlo a Erystia, a Palmia.

jp: ロストイルヴァ北端に存在する神艦から傭兵と一緒にキッカスへ悪魔討伐に向かおう。
jp_grezzo: "ロストイルヴァ北端に存在する神艦から傭兵と一緒にキッカスへ悪魔討伐に向かおう。"
en: I need to join forces with the mercenary waiting at the God's Warship in the northern reaches of Lost Irva to face the demon attacking Kikkasu.
en_grezzo: "I need to join forces with the mercenary waiting at the God's Warship in the northern reaches of Lost Irva to face the demon attacking Kikkasu."
it: Devo partire con il mercenario dalla Nave Divina, all'estremità nord di Irva Perduta, e andare a Kikkasu a combattere il demone.

jp: キッカスの悪魔の討伐をエリステアに報告しよう。
jp_grezzo: "キッカスの悪魔の討伐をエリステアに報告しよう。"
en: The demon in Kikkasu has been defeated. I should report to Erystia in Palmia.
en_grezzo: "The demon in Kikkasu has been defeated. I should report to Erystia in Palmia."
it: Il demone di Kikkasu è stato abbattuto. Devo riferirlo a Erystia, a Palmia.

jp: 混沌の超児を無力化しよう。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の超児を無力化しよう。"
en: I have to neutralize the Chaos Child.
en_grezzo: "I have to neutralize the Chaos Child."
it: È ora di neutralizzare <Il Figlio del Caos>.

jp: ロイターと接触して世界を行き来しつつ、探索していこう。
jp_grezzo: "ロイターと接触して世界を行き来しつつ、探索していこう。"
en: I should explore the area while keeping in touch with <Loyter>.
en_grezzo: "I should explore the area while keeping in touch with <Loyter>."
it: Devo tenermi in contatto con <Loyter> e continuare a esplorare i mondi, andando avanti e indietro.

jp: 混沌の巨城の最深層、神の間を再び目指そう。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の巨城の最深層、神の間を再び目指そう。"
en: I should aim to reach the bottom of the Cradle of Chaos again.
en_grezzo: "I should aim to reach the bottom of the Cradle of Chaos again."
it: Di nuovo verso il Sigillo Eterno, in fondo alla Culla del Caos.

jp: 最後まであきらめずに戦おう。
jp_grezzo: "最後まであきらめずに戦おう。"
en: I must fight until the end without giving up.
en_grezzo: "I must fight until the end without giving up."
it: Devo combattere fino in fondo, senza mai arrendermi.

jp: ・高レベルの相手を倒そう。
jp_grezzo: "・高レベルの相手を倒そう。"
en: I will defeat a higher level enemy.
en_grezzo: "I will defeat a higher level enemy."
it: Abbattere un nemico di livello alto.

en: I will go to sleep between 21:00 and 23:59.
en_grezzo: "I will go to sleep between 21:00 and 23:59."
it: Dormire fra le 21:00 e le 23:59.

jp: ヨウィンのギルバート大佐に、ジューア解放軍の援護を求められた。準備が整い次第、大佐に話し掛けよう。
jp_grezzo: "ヨウィンのギルバート大佐に、ジューア解放軍の援護を求められた。準備が整い次第、大佐に話し掛けよう。"
en: Colonel Gilbert of Yowyn asked me to help the Juere freedom force fight the Yerles Army. I should speak to him again when I'm ready.
en_grezzo: "Colonel Gilbert of Yowyn asked me to help the Juere freedom force fight the Yerles Army. I should speak to him again when I'm ready."
it: Il Colonnello Gilbert, a Yowyn, mi ha chiesto di sostenere l'esercito di liberazione juere. Devo tornare a parlargli quando sono pronto.

jp: ヨウィンのアインクに騎士昇格試験の手伝いを頼まれた。ヨウィンの西にあるイークの洞窟に住むイークの首領を倒せばいいそうだ。
jp_grezzo: "ヨウィンのアインクに騎士昇格試験の手伝いを頼まれた。ヨウィンの西にあるイークの洞窟に住むイークの首領を倒せばいいそうだ。"
en: Ainc of Yowyn asked me to help with his promotion task. I need to enter the Yeek's Nest which is located west of Yowyn and kill their chief.
en_grezzo: "Ainc of Yowyn asked me to help with his promotion task. I need to enter the Yeek's Nest which is located west of Yowyn and kill their chief."
it: Ainc, a Yowyn, mi ha chiesto una mano per l'esame da cavaliere. Basta abbattere il capo degli yeek, nella grotta a ovest di Yowyn.

jp: パルミアのミーアは、稀少猫シルバーキャットが欲しいらしい。なんとか捕まえて、ミーアに渡そう。
jp_grezzo: "パルミアのミーアは、稀少猫シルバーキャットが欲しいらしい。なんとか捕まえて、ミーアに渡そう。"
en: Mia of Palmia wants a silver cat, a very rare cat. If I happen to capture one, I should bring it to Mia.
en_grezzo: "Mia of Palmia wants a silver cat, a very rare cat. If I happen to capture one, I should bring it to Mia."
it: Mia, a Palmia, vorrebbe un gatto d'argento, che è raro. Devo catturarne uno e portarglielo.

jp: ルミエストのレントンが、レイチェルという童話作家によって描かれた絵本を探している。絵本は全部で4巻あるらしい。全て見つけたら、レントンに報告しよう。
jp_grezzo: "ルミエストのレントンが、レイチェルという童話作家によって描かれた絵本を探している。絵本は全部で4巻あるらしい。全て見つけたら、レントンに報告しよう。"
en: Renton of Lumiest is looking for the fairy tale books written by Rachael. I should bring it to him if I happen to find one. There're total of 4 books in the series.
en_grezzo: "Renton of Lumiest is looking for the fairy tale books written by Rachael. I should bring it to him if I happen to find one. There're total of 4 books in the series."
it: Renton, a Lumiest, cerca i libri illustrati della scrittrice di favole Rachael. In tutto sono quattro volumi: quando li ho trovati tutti, devo riferirlo.

jp: 見事にパルミアを壊滅させた。あとはダルフィのノエルの元に戻り、報告するだけだ。
jp_grezzo: "見事にパルミアを壊滅させた。あとはダルフィのノエルの元に戻り、報告するだけだ。"
en: I have successfully destroyed Palmia. Now all I need to report back to Noel in Derphy.
en_grezzo: "I have successfully destroyed Palmia. Now all I need to report back to Noel in Derphy."
it: Ho raso al suolo Palmia. Devo tornare a Derphy e riferirlo a Noel.

jp: カプールのイコールに、実験用の生物5体の捕獲を頼まれた。依頼品、モンスターボールに捕獲したものでなくてはならない。あと個の捕獲済みモンスターボールを届ける必要がある。
jp_grezzo: "カプールのイコールに、実験用の生物5体の捕獲を頼まれた。依頼品、モンスターボールに捕獲したものでなくてはならない。あと" + (6 - gdata(GDATA_FLAG_SUB_BIOLOGIST)) + "個の捕獲済みモンスターボールを届ける必要がある。"
en: Icolle of Port Kapul asked me to bring 5 filled monster balls. I still need to bring him  of them.
en_grezzo: "Icolle of Port Kapul asked me to bring 5 filled monster balls. I still need to bring him " + (6 - gdata(GDATA_FLAG_SUB_BIOLOGIST)) + " of them."
contesto: s1 = lang("カプールのイコールに、実験用の生物5体の捕獲を頼まれた。依頼品、モンスターボールに捕獲したものでなくてはならない。あと" + (6 - gdata(GDATA_FLAG_SUB_BIOLOGIST)) + "個の捕獲済みモンスターボールを届ける必要がある。", "Icolle of Port Kapul asked me to bring 5 filled monster balls. I still need to bring him " + (6 - gdata(GDATA_FLAG_SUB_BIOLOGIST)) + " of them.")
it: "Icolle, a Porto Kapul, mi ha chiesto di catturare 5 creature per i suoi esperimenti. Devono stare dentro una sfera dei mostri. Ne mancano ancora " + (6 - gdata(GDATA_FLAG_SUB_BIOLOGIST)) + " da consegnare."

jp: ルミエストのバルザックに、下水道の清掃を頼まれた。下水道の入り口は宿屋の近くにあるみたいだ。
jp_grezzo: "ルミエストのバルザックに、下水道の清掃を頼まれた。下水道の入り口は宿屋の近くにあるみたいだ。"
en: Balzak of Lumiest wants me to sweep the entire sewer. I can find the entrance to the sewer around the inn.
en_grezzo: "Balzak of Lumiest wants me to sweep the entire sewer. I can find the entrance to the sewer around the inn."
it: Balzak, a Lumiest, mi ha chiesto di ripulire le fogne. L'ingresso sembra essere vicino alla locanda.

jp: 魔術士ギルドに加入するには、ルミエストのメイジギルドの納入箱に、解読済みの古書物を納入し、ギルドポイントを貯めた後、ギルドの番人に話しかけなければならない。審査をクリアするには、あとギルドポイントを獲得する必要がある。
jp_grezzo: "魔術士ギルドに加入するには、ルミエストのメイジギルドの納入箱に、解読済みの古書物を納入し、ギルドポイントを貯めた後、ギルドの番人に話しかけなければならない。審査をクリアするには、あと" + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_GUILD_MAGE_NORMA) + "ギルドポイントを獲得する必要がある。"
en: To join the Mages Guild, I need to gather  more guild points and talk to the guild guard in Lumiest. I can earn the guild points by collecting ancients books, decrypt them, and put them into the delivery box near the guild guard.
en_grezzo: "To join the Mages Guild, I need to gather " + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_GUILD_MAGE_NORMA) + " more guild points and talk to the guild guard in Lumiest. I can earn the guild points by collecting ancients books, decrypt them, and put them into the delivery box near the guild guard."
contesto: s1 = lang("魔術士ギルドに加入するには、ルミエストのメイジギルドの納入箱に、解読済みの古書物を納入し、ギルドポイントを貯めた後、ギルドの番人に話しかけなければならない。審査をクリアするには、あと" + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_GUILD_MAGE_NORMA) + "ギルドポイントを獲得する必要がある。", "To join the Mages Guild, I need to gather " + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_GUILD_MAGE_NORMA) + " more guild points and talk to the guild guard in Lumiest. I can earn the guild points by collecting ancients books, decrypt them, and put them into the delivery box near the guild guard.")
it: "Per entrare nella Gilda dei Maghi devo mettere libri antichi decifrati nel baule delle consegne della gilda, a Lumiest, accumulare punti gilda e poi parlare col guardiano. Per superare l'esame mancano ancora " + gdata(GDATA_FLAG_GUILD_MAGE_NORMA) + " punti gilda."
